scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
Congratulation! Celebrate Feast Day Of Ramadan Idul Fitri 1427 H.
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
恭喜！庆祝1427年伊斯兰历开斋节。

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
Haii......^FF8800{0}^000000!!
First day of Idul Fitri has arrived.
Congratulation celebrate him.
There is event special today.
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
嗨......^FF8800{0}^000000！！
开斋节第一天到了。
恭喜庆祝这一天。
今天有特别活动。

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
Event today.....^009500Idul Fitri Quest!^000000
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
今天的活动.....^009500开斋节任务！^000000

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
If you interest to follow this event, I will cook it to you.
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
如果您有兴趣参加这个活动，我会为您烹饪。

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
I have something that might interest you.
I need all of the following items:
^D5A500Ketupat Sayur Ingredient :^000000
^00B6FF~5 Ketupat, 5 Carrot~,^000000
^CC6633~5 Sweet Potato, 10 Meat~,^000000
^000088~2 Green Herb, 5 Stem~.^000000
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
我有一些您可能感兴趣的东西。
我需要以下所有物品：
^D5A500椰丝糕蔬菜配料：^000000
^00B6FF~5个椰丝糕，5个胡萝卜~，^000000
^CC6633~5个红薯，10个肉~，^000000
^000088~2个绿色药草，5个茎~。^000000

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
You don't have enough items.
Come back when you have them all.
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
您的物品不足。
集齐后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
I see you already have all the items you need.
Just a moment, please!!
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
看来您已经集齐了所有需要的物品。
请稍等！！

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
We appreciate your participation in this special event.
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
感谢您参加这个特别活动。

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
Oh well, maybe you will participate in tommorow's quest.
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
好吧，也许您会参加明天的任务。
